labels.howToCreate: To schedule a transaction, open it in Transactions and choose Repeat from its menu.
labels.name: Name

resume.title: Resume this schedule?
resume.content: Dates that fell while it was paused are skipped. It carries on from the next scheduled date.

delete.title: Delete this schedule?
delete.content: No more transactions will be posted from it. Transactions already posted stay as they are.

form.repeatIntro: {voucherNo} is copied as it is now, so later changes to it do not affect the schedule. Choose when and how often it should be posted.

labels.name: Name
labels.monthEnd: Post on the last day of the month

helper.fixed: Each line is posted with the amount it has now, every time.
helper.total: The amounts of the copied transaction are treated as totals. Each period posts its share, and the last period takes any rounding so the total is exact.
helper.weekdays: Leave empty to use the weekday of the first date.
helper.never: This keeps posting until you pause or delete it. Frequent schedules need an end.
helper.pastStart: A first date in the past posts the missed dates straight away, and needs permission to back-date.
helper.locked: This schedule has already posted, so its dates and amounts cannot change. You can rename it or move its end.
helper.postTime: The posting is dated with this time on its day (your server's timezone). The schedule itself runs once a day at 23:50.

scheduleMode.toggle: Repeat on a schedule instead of posting once
scheduleMode.info: Nothing is posted now. The lines you enter are saved as a schedule and posted on the dates below. The date at the top of the form is not used; the schedule starts on its first date.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel {voucherNo}
cancelDialog.content: This reverses the posting and keeps it on record. The schedule carries on with the next date; this period is not posted again.
